Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Dusk Wool Rug, 8' x 10', Tan
Colors: Tan
Materials: wool
Pile: 80% Wool/20% Cotton, Backing: 100% Jute Imported This beautiful cream-colored rug combines a classic medallion pattern with durable and resilient natural fibers. Neutral colors and classic style will allow this rug to blend with any of your existing styles in high-traffic areas. Classic design with modern durability Hand-hooked in India. 80% wool, 20% cotton. Fashionable with minimal care 8' x 10' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
